meta_description: By joining the Xometry Partner Network, Texas-based Kingdom Precision Machining secured instant demand, accessed jobs from enterprise companies, and gained the freedom of running a family-first business.

Manufacturing Services Offered Specialty Xometry Jobs Completed to Date Xometry Revenue to Date Manufacturing Services Offered Precision CNC machining Specialty 5-axis machining of aerospace and defense components Xometry Jobs Completed to Date 80+ Xometry Revenue to Date $436,700+ Before launching Kingdom Precision Machining in Burleson, Texas, Sam Shebesta worked as a CNC programmer, spending most of his time at a desk instead of working on the shop floor. Hoping to do more hands-on work and achieve a better work-life balance, he started dreaming of owning his own machine shop. Encouraged by a coworker and backed by support from his former employer, Shebesta invested in a 3-axis mill and founded his company in 2023. "I was just thinking about it<dynamic-value>, is this possible? Is this something that I could do?" Shebesta recalled. "From there I was just like, 'Okay, I'm going to take the chance and I'm going to do this.'" After discovering Xometry while sourcing equipment, he joined the Xometry Partner Network in 2024, unlocking the consistent demand he needed to turn his leap of faith into a thriving enterprise. Instant Enterprise Access Close to Home Starting a precision machine shop from scratch often means struggling with cold calls and client acquisition. Partnering with Xometry eliminated that initial barrier entirely. By taking on work through the Xometry Job Board, Shebesta gained immediate access to enterprise-tier accounts. “The work I get from Xometry that I couldn't get on my own would definitely be some of the bigger companies that [order] through Xometry. It's really hard to get your foot in the door with some of these bigger companies,” Shebesta said. Being able to access enterprise-level work for aerospace companies through the Xometry platform is “amazing.” Another key benefit for Shebesta is that Kingdom Precision Machining is located next to his house. Instead of enduring a rigid corporate commute, Shebesta enjoys a combination of hands-on shop work, programming, and quality time with his family. His typical workday looks very different today than it did before he launched his own shop. “The main thing is that I see my family more in the morning. I can see them and wave them goodbye, and then see them when they come back home … Having that freedom as a business owner now is really awesome.” Kingdom Precision Machining owner Sam Shebesta at his shop in Burleson, Texas. Xometry has been very helpful in getting different certifications and things that I need, and equipping me to be in this industry and thrive. Sam Shebesta Owner, Kingdom Precision Machining Support for Certifications and More To maximize production efficiency and tackle tighter tolerances, Shebesta added a 5-axis trunnion tilt to his mill. That forward-looking investment has paid off: Kingdom Precision Machining has completed 82 jobs and generated over $436,000 in revenue through Xometry. During a visit to the shop, Silpa Gollapalli, SVP, Commercial at Xometry, noted the power of Shebesta’s lean, high-output setup. “It's incredible to see how much work they're able to crank out of this one machine. And there's room to grow,” she said. “I’m very excited to see what they've accomplished already, the possibilities, and the role that Xometry has played along the way.” Gollapalli emphasized that Xometry’s focus centers around "the three Cs: capabilities, capacity, and certification." When a supplier prioritizes these three things, scale naturally follows. “We have multitudes of stories where folks have started with one machine in a garage and now are running 30- or 40-machine shops with an incredible growth trajectory,” she said. Shebesta credits Xometry’s hands-on support team with keeping his pipeline running smoothly. The Xometry Partner Team checks in on current projects and supports him in pursuing certifications that will open his shop up to more jobs in the future. “Xometry has been very helpful in getting different certifications and things that I need, and equipping me to be in this industry and thrive,” he said. Grow Your Shop With Xometry Learn how becoming a Xometry Partner can help your business find profitable work, improve cash flow, and maximize shop efficiency. Taking the Leap Leads to Limitless Potential Looking ahead, Shebesta envisions expanding into a larger facility, adding more machines, hiring a dedicated inspection team, and implementing automation for lights-out overnight runs. He currently manages two to three concurrent jobs and plans to scale to 10 or more. For other machinists contemplating stepping out on their own, Shebesta encourages them to take the leap and take advantage of the benefits of working with Xometry. “If somebody's out there working a full-time job right now, but has a machine in their garage, I would say get onto Xometry, apply to be a Partner, and just try it,” he said. “Accept a few jobs and see how much work and money is out there to be made. You're going to realize how awesome it is being your own boss, and how much you can make and provide for your family.” From Day Job to Full-Time Shop Owner Take a look inside Kingdom Precision Machining and hear from owner Sam Shebesta in the pilot episode of Xometry's Manufacturing Fridays video series. For more information, reach out to partneronboarding@xometry.com or start your application .
